feature: FR-03 - Forgot Password and Password Reset

results.expected: OTP request succeeds; reset with valid token and strong password succeeds; new password works.
results.actual: OTP step2Visible=true; reset dialogs=["Mật khẩu quá yếu! Phải dài tối thiểu 8 ký tự, gồm chữ hoa, chữ thường, số và KÝ TỰ ĐẶC BIỆT."]; login new=401; login old=200.

results.expected: Required-field validation prevents OTP request for empty email.
results.actual: Browser required validation blocked empty email submission.

results.expected: Unregistered well-formed email is rejected and no token is produced.
results.actual: Rejected with alert: Lỗi: User not found

results.expected: Malformed email is rejected or fails safely without producing token.
results.actual: No token produced. Alert(s): Lỗi: User not found.

results.expected: Required-field validation prevents reset for empty token.
results.actual: Browser required validation blocked empty token; old login HTTP 200.

results.expected: Reset is rejected by the token domain under test and password remains unchanged.
results.actual: Expected token-domain rejection, but actual dialogs=["Mật khẩu quá yếu! Phải dài tối thiểu 8 ký tự, gồm chữ hoa, chữ thường, số và KÝ TỰ ĐẶC BIỆT."]; oldLogin=200; newLogin=401.

results.expected: Token issued for Account B is rejected when used with Account A.
results.actual: Expected token/email mismatch rejection, but actual dialogs=["Mật khẩu quá yếu! Phải dài tối thiểu 8 ký tự, gồm chữ hoa, chữ thường, số và KÝ TỰ ĐẶC BIỆT."]; oldLogin=200; newLogin=401.

results.expected: Reset is rejected by the token domain under test and password remains unchanged.
